decisions.decision: User waived unavailable Context7 requirement; official documentation and available tools are permitted.

Descriptive handoffs record existing code, not immutable ownership requirements. Explicit supervisor refactoring assignments may change recorded structure while preserving specification requirements.

reusableFindings.finding: Workspace packages resolve runtime imports through compiled dist; build and dependent tests must be sequential.
Root checks initially excluded app/test sources. Verification must report actual source coverage, not only successful package builds.
Use one generic persistent Actor/key host; authority and Territory adapters must not duplicate key storage, routing, or worker lifecycle.
Vessel capacity is mass; warehouse slots are separate local policy. Reservations for shared stock must span all vessels.
Item IDs and Stack data are semantic cargo identity. Local production may reject unsupported ingredients explicitly, but must not silently erase them.
